# Rust API

**Package:** Crate `adxl355-driver` / import `adxl355`

## Capability boundary

Core lifecycle, range, power mode, raw/converted reads, temperature, status, stateless conversions, and optional embedded-hal SPI/I2C adapters.

**Not exposed:** No public ODR, offset, calibration, self-test, FIFO, or interrupt methods.

## Authoritative sources

- [`$rust/src/lib.rs`](../../rust/src/lib.rs)
- [`$rust/src/device.rs`](../../rust/src/device.rs)
- [`$rust/src/hal.rs`](../../rust/src/hal.rs)

## Native documentation command

```bash
cargo doc --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-features --no-deps
```
